scope: Explicit variant subset. Selected variants only; no whole-suite coverage claim. Each supported variant runs in an isolated native process. Synchronous and Promise-job asynchronous Scripts use parsed strictness and unchanged harness sources. Parse/early-negative tests use native syntax validation without evaluation. Unsupported module execution, agents, lowering and runtime operations, as well as harness errors, crashes and timeouts remain in the totals. Runtime-compiled tagged templates retain parsed-unit site identity and use the existing realm template cache. Module and Script-root dynamic imports use a lazy sibling table loader, including imports from runtime-compiled eval and Function bodies. Import helpers and checked referrer views come from the image-owned managed surface. JSON/type validation, top-level await and direct eval are enabled. Proposal phases, text/bytes and undiscovered relative specifiers stay unsupported.
variantPolicy: Every explicit manifest entry validated against pinned paths, source hashes and syntaxVariants; raw/strict/sloppy/module flags retained; fixture files excluded. Syntax-negative files precede execution files, preserving file order within each lane. No unsupported or failed variants excluded from the denominator.

compilation.failurePolicy: A failed batch compilation is retained for every affected variant; no automatic retry.
